title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
code:

Let best start at 0.

For every i from 0 to n - 1:
    For every j from i to n - 1:
        Let repeated be false.
        If j is more than i:

        If repeated is false:
            Let span be j - i + 1.
            If span is more than best:

title: Regular Expression Matching
code:
Let word be "aab".
Let pattern be "c*a*b".
Let n be the number of characters in word.
Let m be the number of characters in pattern.
Let width be m + 1.
Let table be an empty list of whole numbers.
For every index from 0 to (n + 1) * width - 1:
    Append 0 to table.
Set item 0 of table to 1.

For every j from 1 to m:
    If character (j - 1) of pattern is 42 and j >= 2:
        If item (j - 2) of table is 1:
            Set item j of table to 1.

For every i from 1 to n:
    For every j from 1 to m:
        Let slot be i * width + j.
        Let symbol be character (j - 1) of pattern.
        If symbol is 46 or symbol is character (i - 1) of word:
            If item ((i - 1) * width + j - 1) of table is 1:
                Set item slot of table to 1.
        Otherwise:
            If symbol is 42 and j >= 2:
                Let zero match be item (i * width + j - 2) of table.
                Let repeat match be false.
                Let prior be character (j - 2) of pattern.
                If prior is 46 or prior is character (i - 1) of word:
                    If item ((i - 1) * width + j) of table is 1:
                        Set repeat match to true.
                If zero match is 1 or repeat match is true:
                    Set item slot of table to 1.

Print item (n * width + m) of table is 1.

title: Next Permutation
code:
Let nums be a list of 1, 2, and 3.
Let n be 3.
Let pivot start at 1.

While pivot >= 0 and item pivot of nums >= item (pivot + 1) of nums:
    Subtract 1 from pivot.

If pivot < 0:
    Let low start at 0.
    Let high be n - 1.
    Repeat while low < high:
        Let temporary be item low of nums.
        Set item low of nums to item high of nums.
        Set item high of nums to temporary.
        Add 1 to low.
        Subtract 1 from high.
Otherwise:
    Let successor be n - 1.
    While item successor of nums <= item pivot of nums:
        Subtract 1 from successor.
    Let temporary be item pivot of nums.
    Set item pivot of nums to item successor of nums.
    Set item successor of nums to temporary.
    Let low be pivot + 1.
    Let high be n - 1.
    Repeat while low < high:
        Let swap value be item low of nums.
        Set item low of nums to item high of nums.
        Set item high of nums to swap value.
        Add 1 to low.
        Subtract 1 from high.

For each value in nums, print value.

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
code:
Let nums be a list of 4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, and 2.
Let target be 0.
Let n be 7.
Let low start at 0.
Let high be n - 1.
Let answer start at -1.

Repeat while low <= high:
    Let middle be low + (high - low) / 2.
    Let value be item middle of nums.
    If value is target:
        Set answer to middle.
        Set low to high + 1.
    Otherwise:
        Let low value be item low of nums.
        If low value <= value:
            If target >= low value and target < value:
                Set high to middle - 1.
            Otherwise:
                Set low to middle + 1.
        Otherwise:
            Let high value be item high of nums.
            If target > value and target <= high value:
                Set low to middle + 1.
            Otherwise:
                Set high to middle - 1.

Print answer.

title: Valid Sudoku
code:
Let board be a list of 5, 3, 0, 0, 7, 0, 0, 0, 0, 6, 0, 0, 1, 9, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 9, 8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 6, 0, 8, 0, 0, 0, 6, 0, 0, 0, 3, 4, 0, 0, 8, 0, 3, 0, 0, 1, 7, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0, 6, 0, 6, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 4, 1, 9, 0, 0, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 8, 0, 0, 7, 9.
Let valid be true.

For every r from 0 to 8:
    For every c1 from 0 to 8:
        Let value be item (r * 9 + c1) of board.
        If value is not 0:
            For every c2 from c1 + 1 to 8:
                If item (r * 9 + c2) of board is value:
                    Set valid to false.

For every c from 0 to 8:
    For every r1 from 0 to 8:
        Let value be item (r1 * 9 + c) of board.
        If value is not 0:
            For every r2 from r1 + 1 to 8:
                If item (r2 * 9 + c) of board is value:
                    Set valid to false.

For every zone row from 0 to 2:
    For every zone column from 0 to 2:
        For every p from 0 to 8:
            Let inner row be p / 3.
            Let inner column be p - inner row * 3.
            Let value be item ((zone row * 3 + inner row) * 9 + zone column * 3 + inner column) of board.
            If value is not 0:
                For every q from p + 1 to 8:
                    Let other row be q / 3.
                    Let other column be q - other row * 3.
                    Let other be item ((zone row * 3 + other row) * 9 + zone column * 3 + other column) of board.
                    If other is value:
                        Set valid to false.

Print valid.

code:

Let right max be an empty list of whole numbers.

    Let value be item i of heights.
    If value > highest:
        Set highest to value.
    Append highest to left max.

For every i from 0 to n - 1:
    Append 0 to right max.
Set highest to 0.
For every step from 0 to n - 1:
    Let i be n - step.
    Subtract 1 from i.
    Let value be item i of heights.
    If value > highest:
        Set highest to value.
    Set item i of right max to highest.

Let water start at 0.
For every i from 0 to n - 1:
    Let boundary be item i of left max.
    If item i of right max < boundary:
        Set boundary to item i of right max.
    Let depth be boundary - item i of heights.
    If depth > 0:
        Add depth to water.

Print water.

title: Wildcard Matching
code:
Let word be "adceb".
Let glob be "*a*b".
Let n be the number of characters in word.
Let m be the number of characters in glob.
Let width be m + 1.
Let table be an empty list of whole numbers.
For every index from 0 to (n + 1) * width - 1:
    Append 0 to table.
Set item 0 of table to 1.

Let starter be character 0 of glob.
If starter is 42:
    For every i from 0 to n:
        Set item (i * width + 1) of table to 1.

For every j from 1 to m:
    If character (j - 1) of glob is 42 and j >= 2:
        If item (j - 2) of table is 1:
            Set item j of table to 1.

For every i from 1 to n:
    For every j from 1 to m:
        Let slot be i * width + j.
        Let symbol be character (j - 1) of glob.
        If symbol is 46 or symbol is character (i - 1) of word:
            Let diagonal be item ((i - 1) * width + j - 1) of table.
            If diagonal is 1:
                Set item slot of table to 1.
        Otherwise:
            If symbol is 42 and j >= 2:
                Let zero match be item (i * width + j - 2) of table.
                Let repeat match be false.
                Let prior be character (j - 2) of glob.
                If prior is 46 or prior is character (i - 1) of word:
                    If item ((i - 1) * width + j) of table is 1:
                        Set repeat match to true.
                If zero match is 1 or repeat match is true:
                    Set item slot of table to 1.

Print item (n * width + m) of table is 1.

title: Pow(x, n)
code:
Let base be 2.0.
Let exponent be 10.
Let result start at 1.0.
Let factor be base.
Let power be exponent.

Repeat while power > 0:
    If power modulo 2 is 1:
        Set result to result * factor.
    Set factor to factor * factor.
    Set power to power / 2.

Print result.
